name: stoic
description: Stoic is an interactive daily journal with a cited passage from Marcus Aurelius, Seneca or Epictetus, a morning intention, an evening review and a control sorter. Your journal stays in your browser.

interface.longDescription: Stoic is a daily journal built on Stoic practice. Each day brings one passage from Marcus Aurelius, Seneca or Epictetus, quoted word for word from public-domain translations with a full citation. Set a morning intention and prepare for what might go wrong, close the day with an evening review and a four-virtue self-check, and use the control sorter to separate what is up to you from what is not. A 7-day Stoic Foundations challenge, streaks, a year heatmap, search, favourite passages, undo and redo, and JSON or Markdown export are included. The journal runs entirely in the chat; your entries are never sent to a server. For reflection, not a substitute for professional care.
defaultPrompt: Help me set a Stoic intention for today.
